results.boundary_rationale: Headline claim is coverage (is the customer served at all); no timing implied. Answer reads off unserved_customer_ids.
results.prompt_text: Will customer 42 still get a delivery today?

results.boundary_rationale: Same customer-level question with timing modifier (on time). Answer reads off customer_schedule[42].is_late.
results.prompt_text: Will customer 42 still get a delivery on time today?

results.boundary_rationale: Coverage-only question (fit in = serve); no timing. Answer reads off n_unserved_customers.
results.prompt_text: Are there any stops we couldn't fit in?

results.boundary_rationale: Asks for visit sequence on a route; answer is the customer_ids list for route 5. No clock times required.
results.prompt_text: What's the order of stops on route 5?

results.boundary_rationale: Same route but the headline claim is per-stop arrival times. Answer reads off customer_schedule entries for route_idx=5.
results.prompt_text: What time does route 5 hit each stop?

results.boundary_rationale: Visit order on a route. Before/after is sequence-position language; answer comes from the customer_ids list ordering. No timing payload needed.
results.prompt_text: Does route 5 visit customer 12 before or after customer 17?

results.boundary_rationale: Headline claim is total cost. Answer reads off objective_delta_absolute.
results.prompt_text: Did this end up costing more?

results.boundary_rationale: Headline claim is vehicle count. Answer reads off n_routes vs baseline_n_routes.
Route count question. Answer reads off n_routes.
results.prompt_text: Did the number of vehicles go up?

results.boundary_rationale: Capacity overload is a feasibility breakdown. Answer reads off feasibility_breakdown.capacity_ok.
Aggregated total duration vs baseline. Per the family definitions in the system prompt total duration is OBJ; SCHEDULE covers per-customer or per-route timing
results.prompt_text: How much longer overall is the new plan compared to yesterday?

results.boundary_rationale: Specific clock-time check on a route end. Answer reads off route_end_times.
results.prompt_text: Will we still finish the last delivery before 6pm?

results.boundary_rationale: Asks for the next customer in the visit sequence relative to a known customer. No clock anchor; answer reads off customer_ids order on customer 41's route.
results.prompt_text: Which customer comes right after customer 41 on its route?

results.boundary_rationale: Asks for a position in the visit sequence (last). No clock anchor; answer reads off the final element of route 3's customer_ids.
results.prompt_text: Is customer 14 the last stop on route 3?

results.boundary_rationale: Clock-anchored timing query (after 6pm). Answer reads off start_service across customer_schedule entries.
